import os, re, hashlib
from pathlib import Path

file_paths = recursive_listing

created = []  # list of dict: {path,title,content_hash,note_id}

for i, file_path in enumerate(file_paths):
    # read file content
    f = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=file_system_token, file_path=file_path)
    content = f['content']

    filename = Path(file_path).name
    # remove only the final extension
    if '.' in filename:
        stem = filename.rsplit('.', 1)[0]
    else:
        stem = filename
    title = stem.replace('_', ' ')

    # create note
    resp = apis.simple_note.create_note(access_token=simple_note_token, title=title, content=content)
    note_id = resp.get('note_id')

    # hash content for later verification
    content_hash = hashlib.sha256(content.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()

    created.append({'file_path': file_path, 'title': title, 'content_hash': content_hash, 'note_id': note_id})

    print('created', i+1, '/', len(file_paths), 'title:', title, 'note_id:', note_id)

print('total_created:', len(created))

# store in globals
created_notes = created

import hashlib

sn_token=simple_note_token
notes=created_notes

verification=[]
all_ok=True
for item in notes:
    note_id=item['note_id']
    note=apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=sn_token, note_id=note_id)
    note_title=note['title']
    note_content=note['content']
    note_hash=hashlib.sha256(note_content.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
    ok = (note_title==item['title'] and note_hash==item['content_hash'])
    all_ok = all_ok and ok
    verification.append({'note_id':note_id,'title_ok':note_title==item['title'],'content_ok':note_hash==item['content_hash']})

print('verification_count:', len(verification))
print('all_ok:', all_ok)
print('sample_first_5:', verification[:5])

# store
verification_results=verification
